# Instructions

## English

First choose your language and delete the section of the document in the other language.

Answer the questions precisely but briefly: the questions are detailed to guide you so there are many of them.
Don't waste your time repeating the course: you have all documents with you, copying their content is not valuable.
To answer factual questions, you don't need to make sentences: e.g., just write "4." to answer the question "how much are 2 + 2?".

Before you begin:

1.  Type your name in the header of the document, in the author field.
2.  Run the following in the terminal (answer *No* if a message box asks you if you want to close some files):

`quarto publish gh-pages index.qmd`

During your work: render the document regularly (at the end of each question, for example) so that problems do not pile up.

At the end of the exam: save the file, make a commit and push the project to GitHub.
Do not modify the project after the exam has finished.

# English

Instructions are in italics.
Read them carefully.
Questions are in "blockquote" format.
Type your answer below the question.

> How much are 2 + 2?

4

> What is the square root of $\pi$?

```{r}
sqrt(pi)
```

```         
1.772454
```
